verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no interactive API reference and no runnable examples. The docs contain static code snippets, the probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the hosted MCP server offers documentation search and examples, which is a different capability. An auth framework could plausibly ship an interactive reference, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
